title: Import the old-system workbook
intro: Upload the workbook exported from the old system. It is converted on the server in memory and checked against its own Checks sheet; then you load customers, products, prices, opening stock and opening balances one step at a time, each with a dry run before the commit.
notStored: The file itself is not stored anywhere. Only the import rows of each step are kept, as for any import.

setupCard.title: Import the old-system workbook
setupCard.description: Upload the .xlsx from the old system and load it step by step, with the reconciliation and a dry run before each commit.

catalogMissing: Before the products step, add the brands and category {codes} on the owner setup page.
catalogLink: Add them on the setup page

upload.title: 1. Upload and check
upload.fileHint: .xlsx only, up to {mb} MB, at most {rows} rows per sheet.
upload.governorateHint: The old system has no governorate. Mansoura is Dakahlia (EG-DK).
upload.warehouseHint: Usually the main warehouse created on the setup page.
upload.noWarehouse: Create the main warehouse on the setup page first.
upload.startHint: This stages the five steps. Nothing is posted until you commit each step.
upload.open: An import is already open. Finish or abandon it below before uploading a new workbook.

problems.not_xlsx: This is not an .xlsx workbook. Export it from the old system as Excel (.xlsx).
problems.too_large: The file is too large (the limit is {mb} MB).
problems.not_zip: The file is damaged or is not an Excel workbook.
problems.zip_bomb: The file unpacks to far more data than a workbook of this size should. It was refused.
problems.too_many_rows: A sheet has more than {rows} rows. Split the data before importing.
problems.too_many_sheets: The workbook has too many sheets.
problems.unreadable: The workbook could not be read. Open it in Excel, save it again as .xlsx and retry.
problems.missing_sheets: The workbook needs the sheets Customers and Items.
problems.bad_request: The upload was incomplete. Try again.
problems.bad_origin: The upload must come from this page. Reload the page and try again.
problems.decisions_incomplete: Choose "fix to 0" or "skip" for every item with negative stock.
problems.new_negative_items: The corrected workbook has negative-stock items you have not decided on. Abandon this import and start again with the new workbook.
problems.file_rejected: A converted file could not be read back. Report this with the reference.

errors.LEGACY_ORDER: Commit the earlier steps first, in order: customers, products, prices, opening stock, opening balances.
errors.LEGACY_DECISION: The rows do not match your decisions (negative stock or credit balances).
errors.INVALID_STATE: This is no longer possible here. Reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT: This upload was already sent with other content. Reload the page and try again.

recon.title: Reconciliation with the Checks sheet
recon.intro: Each check of the workbook's Checks sheet against what the import will load.
recon.someMismatch: Some checks do not match. Read the notes before you start.
recon.empty: The workbook has no Checks sheet to compare with.

counts.title: What each step will load
counts.barcodes: {count, plural, one {# barcode read from the PDF is not imported; check it with a scanner.} other {# barcodes read from the PDF are not imported; check them with a scanner.}}

negative.title: Items with negative stock
negative.intro: The old system shows these items below zero. They are left out of the opening stock. Decide for each one:
negative.zeroHint: Fix to 0: the item is imported with its price and starts with no stock; count it later.
negative.skipHint: Skip: the item is not imported at all; it stays listed on this import.
negative.name: Item
negative.missing: {count, plural, one {# item still needs} other {# items still need}} a decision.

credits.title: Credit balances
credits.intro: {count, plural, one {# customer has} other {# customers have}} a credit balance in the old system (total {total}). They are held back until you confirm them.
credits.none: No customer has a credit balance.
credits.import: Import the credit balances now, with the opening balances
credits.imported: Credit balances: imported with the opening balances

steps.title: 2. Load step by step
steps.intro: Each step: dry run (checks every row, posts nothing), then commit (all rows in one transaction). A step opens only after the previous one is committed.
steps.commitCheckbox: I checked the dry run. Commit {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in one transaction.
steps.commitConfirm: Commit this step? It cannot be undone; corrections are made as reversals.
steps.emptyHint: The workbook has nothing for this step.
steps.discardedHint: This step's rows were discarded. Upload a corrected workbook for it.
steps.rejectsMore: Showing the first {shown}. The full list is on the batch page.
steps.failure: The commit was refused at row {row}; nothing was posted.
steps.failureNoRow: The commit was refused; nothing was posted.
steps.restage: Upload a corrected workbook for this step
steps.restageHint: Your decisions stay as recorded. The rows of this step are replaced; committed steps stay.

outcome.validated: Dry run passed. You can commit.
outcome.rejected: The dry run found errors. Fix them in the old system or here, then upload a corrected workbook for this step.
outcome.commitRefused: The commit was refused and nothing was posted. See the errors below.

session.abandonCheckbox: Discard the steps that are not committed. Committed steps stay.

quality.title: 3. Data to complete
quality.intro: Open each record and add what is missing. The list updates as you fix them.
